findings: All seven display windows (DECON0 main/windows/window control, DMA0, DSIM0, DSIM1, DCPHY0, DISP_SS) are readable in the state the loader leaves; no abort, SError or hang occurred.
DECON0 is running in command mode (GLOBAL_CON 0x133) with frame counter 1686; DECON1-3 idle. Windows 2 and 3 are on, full-screen, mapped to channels 0 and 1.

RDMA0 and RDMA1 hold 1080x2340 and base 0xfa200000 = the console framebuffer; RDMA2/3 are empty. The enable word is 0x40000000 on all four channels, so it does not distinguish used from unused channels; bit 0 is not an enable bit in the sources read (the S9 donor defines bit 2 busy, bit 4 SFR update force).
DSIM0/1 are not in video mode (stop state); DCPHY0 PLL locked and ready; DPU_MIPI_PHY_CON 1.
The kernel with e1sdisp=2 still runs the probe as PID 1 to its designed exit: the extra reads did not regress NAT-068.
Download Mode came at +79.84 s (loader deadline_s=60), not SEC_UPLOAD; the collector had one boot, no capture error.
